gaps.summary: Production ingress/WAF streamed and chunked request-size enforcement, actor/org/IP rate limits and generation concurrency/denial-of-wallet controls require deployment evidence.
Complete automatically maintained two-tenant negative BOLA corpus is not yet proven for every tenant resource route family.
Context trust labels are implemented but not yet propagated through the production Agent context compiler/runtime and malicious web/Brand Guide E2E.

Every production Browser/Tool/MCP HTTP transport must prove pinned-IP connection, validated Host/SNI semantics, DNS rebinding resistance and redirect revalidation. MCP currently exposes a secure transport port contract but production adapter evidence is absent.
Production-equivalent Sandbox escape suite, seccomp/AppArmor/runtime policy, infrastructure no-host-mount/no-Docker-socket evidence and real egress enforcement remain unverified.
Malware scanning, decompression/zip-bomb limits, EXIF/privacy policy and production parser isolation need end-to-end evidence across supported PDF/image/video/archive types.
Production Secret Manager/workload identity integration and a recorded key-rotation exercise are not yet composed.

NODE-66 now wires blocking pip-audit, Bandit, pnpm audit, Trivy filesystem vuln/secret/misconfiguration scan, CycloneDX SBOM and Sandbox image scan, but latest-head execution, all production image coverage, image digest/signature/provenance and reviewed vulnerability-exception evidence remain required.
NODE-64 global-admin authentication/bootstrap, strong MFA/step-up, shorter privileged session and dual-control policy remain open dependencies.

A guarded blocking ZAP baseline workflow is wired to LUMI_STAGING_URL, but no current-track staging scan evidence exists yet and authenticated/active DAST plus independent penetration/red-team evidence remain required.
NODE-65 production Governance composition and mandatory security/privileged Audit ingress remain open dependencies.
Latest-head NODE-66 hosted CI/security suites, production-like E2E and named Security sign-off must execute; skipped/pre-run jobs are not PASS.

FastAPI security middleware is composed for credential-query rejection, known-length JSON request limits, security headers and production HSTS; production interactive API docs/OpenAPI HTTP surfaces are disabled and development docs use a separate restricted CSP.
Next.js emits CSP/frame/referrer/nosniff/permissions/COOP security headers with production HSTS baseline.
Existing Tool Gateway SSRF policy and regression corpus cover private/link-local/metadata targets, mixed DNS, redirect revalidation, pinned IP handoff, no ambient auth and response limits.
Existing local Docker Sandbox contract enforces network none, readonly root, cap-drop, no-new-privileges, unprivileged user, resource limits, readonly input and command/secret restrictions.
Existing Asset tests cover magic-byte MIME, SVG XSS/external resources/XXE, filename sanitation and signed URL checksum/TTL.
Repository already contains frozen lockfiles plus Dependency Review, CodeQL and Gitleaks workflows; NODE-66 treats their executed status as release evidence rather than assuming green.
Trust-labelled model context and fail-closed Critical/High SecurityReleaseGate core are implemented with tests.

Current-track NODE-66 CI wires blocking pip-audit 2.10.1, Bandit 1.9.4, pnpm high audit, Trivy 0.36.0 filesystem vuln/secret/misconfiguration scanning, CycloneDX SBOM generation and CRITICAL/HIGH Sandbox image scanning.
A separate scheduled/manual ZAP baseline workflow is wired with HTTPS-only staging target validation, blocking findings and no automatic issue mutation; execution evidence remains NODE66-GAP-110.
